item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day is packed, and when it is, meals get skipped or grabbed on the run. Then the evening hits and you're running on empty, which makes stress feel bigger than it is. Eating is not a reward or a distraction. It's fuel for the person you're trying to be. Plan one real meal with protein, and decide when you'll eat it. Put it on your calendar right now.
